title: Adobe puts US online holiday spend at $275.1 billion, up 6.7%

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts US consumers will spend $275.1 billion online between November 1 and December 31, 2026.
facts.quote: forecast that US consumers will spend $275.1 billion on retail websites between November 1 and December 31

facts.fact: Adobe projects US online holiday spending to grow 6.7% in the 2026 season.
facts.quote: The projected growth rate of 6.7% sits almost exactly

facts.fact: Adobe's forecast is based on Adobe Analytics data covering more than 1 trillion visits to US retail sites.
facts.quote: covering more than 1 trillion visits to US retail sites

facts.fact: Adobe's dataset for the forecast includes 100 million SKUs across 18 product categories.
facts.quote: 100 million[SKUs](https://ppc.land/sku/)and 18 product categories

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts Cyber Week (Thanksgiving to Cyber Monday) online sales of $47.5 billion, up 7.4%.
facts.quote: is forecast to generate $47.5 billion, up 7.4% and equal to 17.3% of the season

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts Cyber Monday online sales of $15.1 billion, up 6.2%, as the largest day of the season.
facts.quote: Cyber Monday remains the largest day, at $15.1 billion, up 6.2%.

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts Black Friday online sales of $12.9 billion, up 9.2%.
facts.quote: Black Friday follows at $12.9 billion, growing faster at 9.2%.

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts Thanksgiving Day online sales of $6.9 billion, up 8.5%.
facts.quote: Thanksgiving is forecast at $6.9 billion, up 8.5%.

facts.fact: In 2026 the Cyber Week window runs from Thursday, November 26 to Monday, November 30, according to the article.
facts.quote: In 2026 that window runs from Thursday, November 26 to Monday, November 30

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts electronics online sales of $63.3 billion, up 5.9%, as the largest category.
facts.quote: Electronics, at $63.3 billion (up 5.9%)

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts apparel online sales of $51.3 billion, up 4.7%.
facts.quote: apparel, at $51.3 billion (up 4.7%)

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts furniture online sales of $33.4 billion, up 7.3%.
facts.quote: furniture at $33.4 billion (up 7.3%)

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts grocery online sales of $26.1 billion, up 10.3%.
facts.quote: grocery at $26.1 billion (up 10.3%)

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts toy online sales of $9.6 billion, up 9.6%.
facts.quote: toys at $9.6 billion (up 9.6%)

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts cosmetics online sales of $9.2 billion, up 9.5%.
facts.quote: cosmetics at $9.2 billion (up 9.5%)

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts US online spending of $95.8 billion in October 2026, up 8%.
facts.quote: Adobe expects $95.8 billion to be spent online in October 2026, up 8%

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts $9.9 billion in online spending on October 6 and 7, 2026, up 9.2%, during Amazon's October event.
facts.quote: Nearly $10 billion of it ($9.9 billion, up 9.2%) is expected on October 6 and 7

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts discounts of up to 30% off listed price during Cyber Week.
facts.quote: Adobe expects discounts to reach up to 30% off listed price during Cyber Week.

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts markdowns of up to 14% in early November, up to 21% just before Thanksgiving, and 10-15% through December.
facts.quote: markdowns of up to 14% in early November and up to 21% just before Thanksgiving, falling to 10-15% through December

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts electronics discounts of 30%, compared with 30.1% in 2025.
facts.quote: Electronics**: 30%, against 30.1% in 2025

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts toy discounts of 29%, compared with 28% in 2025.
facts.quote: Toys**: 29%, against 28%

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts TV discounts of 23%, compared with 24.2% in 2025.
facts.quote: TVs**: 23%, against 24.2%

facts.fact: Adobe expects discounts forecast to peak at 19% off listed price during its October event, per the article.
facts.quote: with discounts forecast to peak at 19% off listed price

facts.fact: Adobe expects Cyber Week online sales of personal hygiene products to rise 150%, measured against average September 2026 sales levels rather than year-on-year.
facts.quote: personal hygiene products to rise 150% and clothing basics 210%

facts.fact: Adobe's original 2024 season result was $240.8 billion, up 8.4%, but the new historical chart puts 2024 at $241.4 billion, up 8.7%.
facts.quote: The new chart puts 2024 at $241.4 billion, up 8.7%.
